faqs.a: The Employment Pass qualifying salary starts at S$5,600 per month for general roles and S$6,200 for financial services, applying to new applications since 1 January 2025. The threshold rises with age, reaching around S$11,800 for candidates over 45, and only fixed monthly salary counts toward it.
faqs.q: What is the Employment Pass minimum salary in 2026?

faqs.a: COMPASS is the points-based Complementarity Assessment Framework used for most Employment Pass applications. It scores candidates on salary relative to local norms, qualifications, workforce diversity and support for local employment, plus bonus points for skills shortages and strategic economic priorities. Applicants need 40 points to pass.
faqs.q: How does the COMPASS framework work?

faqs.a: Tech.Pass closes to new and renewal applications on 28 January 2027. It required a last-drawn fixed monthly salary of S$22,500 plus five years of leading-role experience in tech. From 2027 it is replaced by a new ONE Pass track for AI and technology talent with outstanding achievements.
faqs.q: Is the Tech.Pass still available in 2026?

faqs.a: ONE Pass targets top global talent earning a fixed monthly salary of at least S$30,000 over the past year, or outstanding achievers in fields including technology. It runs for five years, is renewable, and lets holders work for multiple companies and start businesses, unlike the employer-tied Employment Pass.
faqs.q: Who qualifies for the ONE Pass?

headline: Singapore Tech Visa 2026: Employment Pass, ONE Pass and Tech.Pass
metaDescription: Singapore tech visa 2026: Employment Pass from S$5,600, ONE Pass at S$30,000 for top talent, Tech.Pass closing January 2027. COMPASS scoring explained.

sections.content:
The Employment Pass is Singapore's main work pass for foreign professionals, managers and executives in tech. The employer applies on the candidate's behalf, and the qualifying salary starts at S$5,600 per month for general roles and S$6,200 for financial services, rising with the candidate's age.

Most EP applications go through COMPASS, the Complementarity Assessment Framework, which awards points for salary competitiveness, qualifications, workforce diversity and local employment support. Forty points are needed to pass, with bonus points available for shortage occupations and strategic economic priorities.
sections.title: Employment Pass and COMPASS for Tech Workers

sections.content:
The Overseas Networks and Expertise Pass targets top global talent, including senior tech leaders. Applicants need a fixed monthly salary of at least S$30,000 over the previous twelve months, or outstanding achievements in fields such as technology, science or academia.

ONE Pass runs for five years and is renewable. Unlike the employer-tied Employment Pass, it lets holders work for multiple companies, change employers freely and start or run businesses. From 2027 a new ONE Pass track specifically for AI and technology talent replaces the outgoing Tech.Pass.
sections.title: ONE Pass for Top Tech Talent

sections.content:
Tech.Pass was aimed at established tech leaders, entrepreneurs and technical experts, requiring a last-drawn fixed monthly salary of S$22,500 and five years of leading-role experience. It granted two years initially, renewable once for another two years.

New and renewal applications close on 28 January 2027. Holders should plan their next step early: the Personalised Employment Pass, which also requires S$22,500 in fixed salary and runs once for three years, or the new ONE Pass AI and technology track are the natural alternatives.
sections.title: Tech.Pass and Its Closure

sections.content:
Start with the Ministry of Manpower's Self-Assessment Tool to check whether the salary and profile meet current requirements before applying. The employer then submits the EP application online, with most decisions in three to eight weeks.

Salaries must be fixed monthly pay: bonuses and commissions do not count toward thresholds. EP holders earning enough can bring dependants, and experienced tech professionals in shortage occupations may qualify for a five-year EP from around S$10,700 per month, age-adjusted.
